name: Brachial Plexopathy
definition: Disorder of the brachial plexus causing motor, sensory and pain deficits not confined to a single nerve root or peripheral nerve.

typical: Severe shoulder/arm pain followed by weakness in inflammatory plexopathy

core: Root, plexus and peripheral nerve localization

investigations.principle: Localization requires clinical and electrodiagnostic correlation.
investigations.MRI: MRI plexus/cervical spine may identify structural causes.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs may assist trauma assessment only.

amber: Surgical or immunologic treatment depends on cause and severity.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Upper-limb Vata-neurological phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Disorder of the brachial plexus causing motor, sensory and pain deficits not confined to a single nerve root or peripheral nerve.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
